description: Explain one ILOSTAT dataset before comparing numbers: its definition, unit and multiplier, frequency variants and coverage, the sex and breakdown codes in use across its frequencies (the total code of each breakdown marked), the reference areas it covers, whether it carries World/regional/income-group aggregates, and how its observations are classed as reported, modelled, or projected. Accepts a dataset ID (UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A) or a bare indicator code (UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT), which describes every frequency. An unknown code returns found: false with guidance.

dataset_id.description: One dataset ID (indicator code plus _A, _Q, or _M, e.g. UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A) or a bare indicator code (UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT), as ilostat_search_indicators returns them. Case-insensitive; a DF_ prefix (the SDMX dataflow form) is stripped.

name: ilostat_describe_indicator

attribution.description: Citation to keep with any use of the data.

basis_rule.description: How observations are classed reported, modelled_estimate, or projection.

database_is_modelled.description: Whether the whole database is the ILO modelled estimates (ILOEST).

edition.description: The edition the cutoff derives from, e.g. Nov. 2025.

modelled_source_label.description: Source label that marks an observation as an ILO modelled estimate.

projection_after_year.description: Last year counted as an estimate; later modelled years are projections.

projection_rule.description: How the cutoff was set: the label's edition, the catalog's latest ILO modelled estimates edition, or the year before the current year.

breakdowns.description: Breakdown codes in use, from ILOSTAT's structure service; absent when structure_status is unavailable.

codes.description: Codes ILOSTAT's structure service lists for this breakdown that ilostat_query_indicator accepts as classif1; classification group headers excluded. The list covers every frequency of the indicator, so a code may have no rows in one dataset.

is_total.description: Whether the code is the total of its breakdown.

type.description: Classification type of classif1 (e.g. AGE, ECO, DCL).

codes.description: Codes ILOSTAT's structure service lists for this breakdown that ilostat_query_indicator accepts as classif2; classification group headers excluded. The list covers every frequency of the indicator, so a code may have no rows in one dataset.

is_total.description: Whether the code is the total of its breakdown.

type.description: Classification type of classif2 (e.g. AGE, ECO, DCL).

sex.description: Whether the dataset has a sex breakdown.

sex_codes.description: Sex codes the dataset uses (SEX_T total).

catalog_as_of.description: ISO timestamp the catalog was last confirmed current.

dataset_id.description: The dataset requested, when a dataset ID (not a bare indicator code) was given.

datasets.description: Every frequency variant of the indicator, annual first.

items.description: One frequency variant of the indicator.

data_end.description: Last year with data (can include projection years).

has_aggregates.description: Whether this dataset carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

last_update.description: Last upstream update, ISO 8601 without zone offset.

n_records.description: Best-source observations an unfiltered download returns.

default_slice.description: The dataset's total codes from its default view — the slice ilostat_compare_geographies uses when sex, classif1, or classif2 is omitted; a breakdown with no total (deciles) is left out.

definition.description: ILOSTAT definition of the indicator, HTML stripped; links kept as "text (url)".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: False when no dataset or indicator has the code.

guidance.description: On a miss: how to find a valid dataset ID.

has_aggregates.description: Whether the requested dataset (or, for an indicator code, any of its datasets) carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

label.description: Indicator label as ILOSTAT publishes it.

measure.description: Measure (the quantity measured, shared by breakdown variants) code and label.

code.description: Measure (the quantity measured, shared by breakdown variants) code.

label.description: Measure (the quantity measured, shared by breakdown variants) label.

notice.description: Where to find breakdown codes and units when the structure service did not supply them.

ref_areas.description: Reference areas the indicator covers across its frequencies, from ILOSTAT's structure service; absent when structure_status is unavailable.

related_datasets.description: Up to 20 other indicators sharing this measure under other breakdowns.

items.description: An indicator measuring the same quantity.

structure_status.description: unavailable when ILOSTAT's structure service has no entry for the indicator or cannot be reached; breakdowns, default_slice, unit, and ref_areas are then absent.

unit.description: Unit of the values, already in the multiplier scale; absent when unresolved.

measure.description: Unit code (PT percent, PS persons, LC local currency, …).

multiplier.description: Power of ten values are expressed in: 0 units, 3 thousands, 6 millions.

type.description: Unit type code (RT rate, NB number, …).

title: Describe an ILOSTAT dataset
